name: Brandon Aubrey

background.fact: Brandon Scott Aubrey was born March 14, 1995. He plays placekicker for the Dallas Cowboys and has also played professional soccer as a center back.
He played four years of college soccer at Notre Dame (2013 to 2016); the 2013 team won a national championship and in 2016 he was a third team All-American and first team All-ACC.

Toronto FC drafted him in 2017 and he played for its reserve side and then Bethlehem Steel FC, before switching to football with the USFL Birmingham Stallions in 2022 and 2023. The Cowboys signed him in 2023.

He has a 88.2 percent career field goal rate (fifth best in NFL history per Wikipedia), has been All-Pro in each of his first three seasons, and holds the NFL record for career field goals of 60 yards or longer, with seven.

scouts_read: Aubrey is healthy and set to kick, so the question is volume and range. Dallas plays at home indoors in a game with a total near 55, and the Cowboys score about 27 points a game, so he should get several extra points and likely two or three field goal tries. His long kicks have been shaky this year, 3 of 8 from 50 or longer, which has lowered his average to 9.33 against 11.04 last season. Dallas has publicly backed him, and the home, indoor setting is the best one he has had. I would project a solid game of 9 to 12 points with a chance of a 14 point day if he hits one from 50 or more.
